mapper.select: select WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_id tradeId, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.finprod_id finprodId, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.ps ps, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_date tradeDate, (case when WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Finprod_Type2 = '${finprodtype}' then IFNULL(fdp.pledge_number*100,0) else WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.prin_amt end ) prinAmt, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_status tradeStatus, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.counter_id counterId, wfl_trd_product_deal_oth.repo_type repoType, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.finprod_type2 finprodType2, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.f_trade_id fTradeId from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL left join wfl_trd_product_deal_oth on WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_id=wfl_trd_product_deal_oth.trade_id and WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.workflow_status=wfl_trd_product_deal_oth.workflow_status left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdp on WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Id = fdp.finprod_id where WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL (TRADE_ID, FEE_TYPE, IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE, FEE_AMT, CHL_FINPROD_ID, FEE_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values concat(IFNULL(TRADE_ID,''), 'R'), FEE_TYPE, IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE, FEE_AMT, CHL_FINPROD_ID, FEE_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL WHERE TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

INSERT INTO PTL_TRADE (PORTFOLIO_ID, BUSI_NO, BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values PORTFOLIO_ID, concat(IFNULL(BUSI_NO,''), 'R'), BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PTL_TRADE WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{deal.portfolioId} AND BUSI_NO = #{deal.busiNo} AND BUSI_TABLE = #{deal.busiTable}

INSERT INTO PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL (TRADE_ID, THEORY_RATE, ACT_RATE, THEORY_INT, BASIS, REMAIN_PRIN_AMT, BRANCH, PA_BUSS_TYPE, DEPT_CODE, ACON_SHARE_AMT, BCON_SHARE_AMT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values concat(IFNULL(TRADE_ID,''),'R'), THEORY_RATE, ACT_RATE, THEORY_INT, BASIS, REMAIN_PRIN_AMT, BRANCH, PA_BUSS_TYPE, DEPT_CODE, ACON_SHARE_AMT, BCON_SHARE_AMT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

INSERT INTO TRD_TRADE_FEE_TOTAL ( TOTLE_TRADE_ID, FEE_TYPE, IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE, FEE_AMT, CHL_FINPROD_ID, FEE_ID, FEE_RATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values concat(IFNULL(TOTLE_TRADE_ID,''),'R'), FEE_TYPE, IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE, FEE_AMT, CHL_FINPROD_ID, FEE_ID, FEE_RATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_TOTAL WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
